brief:
Israeli settlers have established a new outpost in the northern West Bank, resuming settlement expansion in the region after a period of relative quiet, the Ma'an news agency reported. The move represents a shift in settlement activity following previous slowdowns in construction and land seizure in the area.

The establishment of the settlement underscores ongoing disputes over Israeli settlement policy in occupied Palestinian territory. Israeli authorities have long promoted settlement expansion across the West Bank, a practice Palestinians and much of the international community view as illegal under international law. The precise location, size, and formal status of the new outpost remain undefined in current reporting.
title: Israel establishes new settlement in northern West Bank
